SRC-375:R001.text: MISSION 1: TRACE THE REAL PUBLICATION CONTRACT Find the exact release admission owner and its accepted grant kind. Determine whether a complete authenticated release-authorization mechanism already exists. If it exists, connect the existing decision-request workflow to that owner instead of inventing a second authority system. If it does not exist, implement the smallest integrated, broker-backed release authorization contract. Do not use retirement, handoff, goal, gate-decision, or campaign authority as implicit permission to publish.

SRC-375:R002.text: MISSION 2: BUILD AN ACTUAL HUMAN APPROVAL SURFACE Implement or connect a supported local operator-controlled approval interaction, usable while Antigravity remains the primary execution host. Present the exact repository, remote URL, branch, reviewed cohort, expected resulting commit, test gate, publication effects, expiration, and grant limits. The operator must explicitly approve that exact transaction through a genuinely authenticated mechanism. The model must not be able to synthesize the approval event by running a shell command, editing a file, or invoking a fake UI. Use real host/broker identity verification, challenge binding, anti-replay protection and durable revocation. Do not fabricate signatures, host ancestry, human events or broker receipts.

SRC-375:R003.text: MISSION 3: SUPPORT BOUNDED STANDING RELEASE AUTHORITY If the canonical authority model supports it, offer one explicit operator opt-in covering repeated verified releases to the SAME approved repository and branch. Bind it to: - exact project identity; - fixed remote and repository visibility; - reviewed SAIPEN-owned code; - required verification policy; - finite duration and operation count; - no force-push; - no deletion of foreign work; - revocation and cancellation; - independent remote verification. Changes of repository, public/private visibility, protected scope, or destructive Git operations require new approval. Do not silently issue or renew a standing grant.

SRC-375:R004.text: MISSION 4: FINISH THE ACTUAL RELEASE CANDIDATE Reconcile the live GitHub branch and the intended integration. Freeze the real final release commit identity. Run the mandatory full release gate against those exact bytes. Focused tests are not a substitute for a mandatory full gate. If the gate fails, investigate and repair genuine regressions; never waive the test policy merely to enable publication. Preserve the shared Git index and all unrelated staged entries.

SRC-375:R005.text: MISSION 5: PUBLISH AND VERIFY Only after genuine operator approval and all required gates: perform the authorized non-force publication. Independently fetch the actual GitHub target branch and verify the exact intended commit or formally permitted merge result. Store broker and publication receipts separately. Never call HELD a successful publication.

SRC-375:R006.text: MISSION 6: MAINTAIN AUTONOMOUS ENGINEERING Keep the existing valid maintenance authority independent of release approval. Do not stop authorized Work, HUNT, Improve, SAIPAL discovery or persistent-goal evaluation because GitHub publication is held. Avoid redundant status polling and artificial tickets.
